repair.duplicateKeysError: Duplicate environment variable names found. Please check and try again.
repair.onlineHint: A connection was established successfully. Note: "online" only means the agent is reachable — it does not mean it is logged in or authorized. If this tool needs an API key or access token, add it under Environment Variables below.
repair.offlineHint: The command was found but the connection failed. Check the error above, then adjust the launch path or environment variables below.
repair.missingHint: The command wasn't found on the default path. If it is installed, specify its full launch path below.
repair.uncheckedHint: This agent hasn't been connection-tested yet. Click "Test Connection" in the top-right to check it.
repair.envScenarioApiKey: Missing API key or access token (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY) — the common cause of "needs sign-in" / connection failures
repair.envScenarioBaseUrl: Custom API endpoint or gateway (e.g. ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, OPENAI_BASE_URL) for self-hosted or proxied services
repair.envScenarioProxy: Network proxy settings (e.g. HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY) when the agent cannot reach the internet directly
repair.envOauthNote: Note: this cannot replace an account login inside the CLI (e.g. signing in to Gemini with a Google account). For OAuth-based login, sign in via the CLI in a terminal.
repair.emptyOverridesError: Enter a launch path or at least one environment variable before saving.

assetPublish.title: Publish to TjuaeHub
assetPublish.notConfiguredDescription: This installation has no Tjuae GitHub App client ID. You can still generate a safe preview and use the manual PR flow.
assetPublish.connectDescription: Authorization is encrypted per user and stored only by TjuaeCore.
assetPublish.authorizationInstructions: Enter this one-time code on the GitHub verification page:
assetPublish.insufficientPermissions: This authorization does not have the permissions required to publish to TjuaeHub.
assetPublish.author: Author
assetPublish.invalidAuthor: The author must be no more than 128 characters.
assetPublish.licenseRequired: Enter the license under which this asset is published.
assetPublish.invalidLicense: The license must be no more than 128 characters.
assetPublish.licensePlaceholder: For example: MIT, Apache-2.0, or Proprietary
assetPublish.sourceRepositoryRequired: Enter the asset's public source repository.
assetPublish.invalidSourceRepository: Enter a valid HTTPS repository URL.
assetPublish.legalMetadataNotice: These values are published as legal attribution. Tjuae does not infer or replace them.
assetPublish.metadataConfirmation: I confirm that the author and license above are accurate and that I am authorized to publish this asset.
assetPublish.metadataConfirmationRequired: Confirm the author, license, and your authorization to publish.
assetPublish.invalidPackageName: The name must start with tjuaeasset- and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens.
assetPublish.invalidVersion: Enter a complete semantic version such as 1.0.0.
assetPublish.previewRequired: Generate a safe preview before publishing. Core validates paths, digests, and sensitive content before any remote write.
assetPublish.warningSensitiveFieldsRemoved: Sensitive fields or local absolute paths were removed from the public package and must be configured again after installation.
assetPublish.warningUnknown: The publication preview reported an unknown security warning ({{code}}).
assetPublish.publishSuccess: The publication branch and pull request were created.

assetProtocol.buildMismatchDescription: This interface requires TjuaeCore {{expected}}, but {{actual}} is running. Rebuild or replace TjuaeCore, then retry.
